evidence.claim: The bank's second-generation fraud model scored transaction 3536052 at 0.997 with a calibrated historical fraud rate of 0.921, while the legacy real-time risk score remained low at 0.15.

Device D007135 has a generic profile ('Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1365x768'), status 'Found', no proxy, and was used on 10 cards in the 30-day window with zero fraud and 9 other cards having model scores below 0.01.

Transaction 3536052 occurred in billing region 476, an established region for card C07196-K2 with 15 prior transactions, consistent with in-person transaction 3508425 on 2016-12-02 and online transaction 3525549 on 2016-12-08.

Card C07196-K2 and device D007135 are not part of any fraud ring (ring_id -1), and shared-origin analysis for D007135 over a 7-day window showed only 1 card with a model score over 0.5 (the alert card itself) and no agent fraud cases.

Prior closed case CC-5401 on card C07196-K2 was an alert triggered by a model score of 0.95 on a $1,502.41 transaction that was cleared as legitimate travel, and similar model-only monitoring alerts (CC-1422, CC-0702, CC-3092, CC-0362, CC-0582, CC-0292) were all cleared.

The transaction amount of $450.06 fits within the cardholder's spending profile (prior in-person purchase 3528438 was $582.96 and cleared case CC-5401 was $1,502.41), with no card testing micro-authorizations observed.
The cardholder has not disputed transaction 3536052, the holder identity has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases, and no testing sequences or compromised credentials were detected.

evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Monitoring alert MON-021 was flagged due to an automated model score of 0.997 on online transaction 3536052 ($450.06) on card C07196-K2, despite a low legacy risk score of 0.15. The transaction originated from the cardholder's established billing region 476 using a recognized, non-proxy device with no fraud ring links. Similar model-only alerts on this card (such as cleared case CC-5401) proved to be false positives, and the transaction amount fits normal spending history. Following cardholder confirmation of the purchase, the alert was determined to be legitimate customer activity.
